summary: PUC standards for interconnecting large loads in ERCOT apply only to new or expanded interconnections where total load at a single site would exceed a demand threshold of 75 MW, unless the PUC finds a lower threshold necessary. Large loads must disclose substantially similar requests elsewhere in Texas, disclose on-site backup generation, pay a flat screening study fee of at least $100,000, and post financial commitments; municipal utilities and co-ops may impose additional requirements.

source.citation: Texas SB 6 (89th Leg., enrolled; effective June 20, 2025), LegiScan mirror
